title: 第8章 李少爷的请求第9章 郭啸天
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
陈锋刚刚离开了学校，就看到学校门口停着一辆劳斯莱斯幻影，而一个人正笑嘻嘻的看着他，对方正是李聪聪，李家大少爷。
李聪聪过来的时候郭龙一伙已经离开了，所以他并不知道学校里发生的事情，并不知道陈锋和五口堂有了矛盾。
“陈大师，我听说你的姑妈在这里上学我就猜到你应该会来，总算找到了你了。”
李聪聪走到了陈锋面前，伸手递给陈锋一根雪茄，然后他拿出打火机帮陈锋点燃。
“哦，李少你怎么会来找我，对了你家的那个蛇妖的情况处理的如何？”
陈锋吸了一口香烟后，目光看着李聪聪。
“我正想说呢，上次陈大师你给我的那个剑符箓牛逼爆炸了，将那蛇妖斩杀了。所以为了感谢陈大师拯救了我一命，为了感谢陈大师帮助我除妖，这栋住宅送给您。”
李聪聪笑嘻嘻的解释那晚上的情况，然后他拿出了一把钥匙递给了陈锋。
陈锋看了看钥匙上的编号，写的乃是黄山1号。
他忽然想到了黄山一号似乎是楚州最贵最豪华的住宅，位于黄山山顶，住宅面积高达万平米，当真是楚州第一豪宅。
黄山1号据说价值5个亿，实在贵的不行。
“哦，这么贵重的东西送给我，李少真是大手笔啊，李少莫非有什么事情找我帮忙？”
陈锋笑嘻嘻的道，他猜测李少爷应该有事情求他，不然不可能送他这么贵的东西，毕竟有句话说得好，无功不受禄。
“哈哈，陈大师果然聪明的很，我的确是有事情求陈大师帮忙，不过在我说出情况之前，陈大师能否告诉下我的您是修法大师还是武者？”
李聪聪眼睛直勾勾的看着陈锋，他似乎想要看出陈锋身上的的秘密。
李聪聪很奇怪，那天他看到陈锋用树叶劈开了子弹，那么则明显是武者，而且是武功高强内力深厚的武者。
不过陈锋又会画符箓，这明显又是修法一途的手段，于是他搞不懂了陈锋到底是武者，还是修法大师。
“哦，这个武者是什么鬼？修法大师是什么？”
陈锋吐出一口烟雾，似笑非笑的看着李聪聪。
陈锋刚刚从昆仑山下来，对于地球上华夏国的这方面不是很懂，他正好请教下。

“啊，陈大师你这都不知道？”
听到陈锋的话，李聪聪无语了，不过他还是解释起来：“修法大师就是会法术的存在，比如泰国降头师，华夏国道士之类的都算，比如电影僵尸先生里面的道士都是修法大师，当然会画符箓也是修法大师。”
“那武者了？”
“武者则是武林高手，武者分为外劲武者和内劲武者，外劲武者比如日国的空手道，棒子国的跆拳道，我们国家的猴拳螳螂拳什么的偶属于外劲；而内劲就不一样了，内劲武者可比外劲厉害多了。内劲武者是修炼出来了内力的，内劲武者可以飞檐走壁，有的甚至能飞花摘叶子即可伤人。”
“另外内劲武者和外劲武者不一样，因为内劲武者是分等级的，分为内劲入门，内劲小成，内劲大成，内劲巅峰，内劲武者后面还有宗师，陈大师你明明是武者怎么会不知道了，那次你用树叶劈开了子弹，您的境界起码到了内劲大成了吧。”
李聪聪着急的询问，他不确定陈锋是真的不知道还是假的不知道。
“哦，原来如此。”
听到李聪聪的话，陈锋似乎明白了什么，刚才被他打飞的那个五口堂的雷豹应该属于外劲武者，因为对方虽然力气很大但是明显没什么内力。
而陈锋自己，他也不知道他筑基期的境界属于什么水平，不过有一点肯定的，就是他起码也是宗师的存在啊，在华夏他应该属于武道宗师，不然就太丢人了。
“至于我是武者还是修法大师都不重要，不过我可以告诉你的是，无论你遇到了什么麻烦我都能帮你搞定。李少请你告诉我需要我做什么？”
陈锋微笑道，他知道李少送他这么贵的豪华住宅，自然是有目的需要他帮忙，说难听就是利用他。
不过陈锋也不生气，毕竟这个世界上本来就是如此，人和人之间就是互相利用的，不怕你利用，就怕你没利可用。因为利用别人也是要付出代价的，比如送对方一套住宅宅或者给对方钱。
如果一个人让人利用的价值都没有的话，那么真的是一种悲哀，这种人一般也是混的很惨的底层的存在，没有人搭理，当然也没人给他好处。
这种人就好比地上的垃圾一样，和乞丐一样，人见了都绕着走。
“陈大师你这么说我就开心了，我希望万一有一天我李家遇到了危难的话，遇到了灭顶之灾的话，我希望您能出手帮帮我们。”
李聪聪很高兴，他想了想说道。
“哦，李家危难，你们李家会有危险吗？”
陈锋好奇的询问，毕竟他知道李家乃是楚州四大家族之一，这么有钱的家族会有什么危险了。
“哎，陈大师你有所不知，我们李家虽然很强很有钱，不过这些年来也得罪了很多人的，那些人不乏很多有实力的。而且我的堂哥堂姐都在去年在京城莫名其妙的死掉了，谁能保证自己一生安全了，当然我只是先买个保险而已，万一真的有那么一天我们李家遭遇灭顶灾难，我希望陈大师能够出手帮我们一下。”
李聪聪脸色郑重的看着陈锋。

李聪聪知道陈锋很强，能用树叶劈开子弹的存在是他生平罕见的，这样的强大武者是完全能帮他们李家忙的，他这是在给李家找一个防护罩。
“呵呵好的，如果真有那么一天我一定助你们，我不会白要你这别墅的。”
陈锋也笑了笑，毕竟人家都送了他一栋别墅了，他自然没理由拒绝了。

content_en:
Chen Feng had just left school when he saw a Rolls-Royce Phantom parked at the school gate, and a man was looking at him with a smile. The other person was Li Congcong, the eldest son of the Li family.
Guo Long and his group had already left when Li Congcong came over, so he didn't know what happened in the school or that Chen Feng had a conflict with Wukoutang.
"Master Chen, I heard that your aunt goes to school here and I guessed that you would come. I finally found you."
Li Congcong walked up to Chen Feng and handed Chen Feng a cigar. Then he took out a lighter and helped Chen Feng light it.
"Oh, Mr. Li, why did you come to me? How did you handle the situation with the snake demon in your house?"
After Chen Feng took a puff of cigarette, he looked at Li Congcong.
"I was just about to say that the sword talisman you gave me last time, Master Chen, exploded and killed the snake demon. So in order to thank Master Chen for saving my life, and to thank Master Chen for helping me get rid of the demon, this house is given to you."
Li Congcong explained what happened that night with a smile, and then he took out a key and handed it to Chen Feng.
Chen Feng looked at the number on the key, and it was Huangshan No. 1.
He suddenly thought that Huangshan No. 1 seemed to be the most expensive and luxurious residence in Chuzhou. It was located at the top of Huangshan Mountain.
Huangshan No. 1 is said to be worth 500 million, which is really expensive.
"Oh, Mr. Li is really generous to give me such a valuable thing. Could it be that Mr. Li wants my help with something?"
Chen Feng said with a smile. He guessed that Master Li had something to ask him for, otherwise it would be impossible to give him such an expensive thing. After all, there is a saying that goes without reward.
"Haha, Master Chen is indeed very smart. I do have something to ask Master Chen for help, but before I tell you the situation, can Master Chen tell me whether you are a master of cultivation or a warrior?"
Li Congcong looked directly at Chen Feng, as if he wanted to see Chen Feng's secrets.
Li Congcong was very surprised. That day he saw Chen Feng splitting bullets with leaves, so he was obviously a warrior, and a warrior with strong martial arts skills and deep internal strength.
However, Chen Feng could draw talismans, which was obviously a method of practicing law, so he couldn't figure out whether Chen Feng was a warrior or a master of law practice.
"Oh, what the hell is this warrior? Who is the master of cultivation?"
Chen Feng exhaled a puff of smoke and looked at Li Congcong with a half-smile.
Chen Feng had just come down from Kunlun Mountain and didn't know much about this aspect of China on Earth, so he just wanted to ask for advice.
"Ah, Master Chen, you don't know this?"
Hearing Chen Feng's words, Li Congcong was speechless, but he still explained: "A master of magic is a being who knows magic, such as a Thai head-turning master, a Chinese Taoist priest, etc. For example, the Taoist priests in the movie Mr. Zombie are all masters of magic. Of course, they are also masters of magic if they can draw talismans."
"What about the warrior?"
"Warriors are martial arts masters. Warriors are divided into external strength warriors and internal strength warriors. External strength warriors, such as karate in Japan, Taekwondo in Bangzi Kingdom, and monkey fist and mantis boxing in our country, are external strength. But internal strength is different. Internal strength warriors are much more powerful than external strength. Internal strength warriors have cultivated internal strength. Internal strength warriors can fly over walls and fly over walls, and some can even fly flowers and pick leaves to hurt people."
"In addition, inner strength warriors are different from external strength warriors, because inner strength warriors are divided into levels. They are divided into entry level of inner strength, minor achievement of inner strength, great achievement of inner strength, and peak inner strength. Behind the inner strength warriors there are grandmasters. Master Chen, how could you not know that you are obviously a martial artist? That time you split the bullet with a leaf, you must have reached the level of inner strength at least."
Li Congcong asked anxiously. He was not sure whether Chen Feng really didn't know or was pretending not to know.
"Oh, that's it."
After hearing Li Congcong's words, Chen Feng seemed to understand something. Just nowThe Wukoutang Thunder Leopard that he knocked away should belong to an external martial artist, because although the opponent was very strong, he obviously had no internal strength.
As for Chen Feng himself, he doesn't know what level he is in during the foundation building stage, but one thing is certain, that is, he is at least a master. In China, he should be considered a martial arts master, otherwise it would be too embarrassing.
"It doesn't matter whether I am a warrior or a master of cultivation, but what I can tell you is that no matter what trouble you encounter, I can help you solve it. Mr. Li, please tell me what you need me to do."
Chen Feng smiled and said, he knew that Mr. Li gave him such an expensive luxury house, so he naturally needed his help for a purpose. To put it bluntly, he was just using him.
But Chen Feng is not angry. After all, this is how the world is. People use each other. I am not afraid that you will take advantage of them, but I am afraid that you will not be able to use them. Because there is a price to pay for using others, such as giving them a house or giving them money.
If a person has no value for others to use, then it is really sad. Such people are usually at the bottom of the society and have a miserable life. No one cares about them, and of course no one gives them any benefits.
This kind of person is like garbage on the ground, like a beggar, people will walk around when they see him.
"Master Chen, I'm happy when you say that. I hope that if one day my Li family encounters a crisis or a disaster, I hope you can help us."
Li Congcong was very happy, he thought for a while and said.
"Oh, the Li family is in danger. Will your Li family be in danger?"
Chen Feng asked curiously. After all, he knew that the Li family was one of the four major families in Chuzhou. What danger could such a wealthy family be in?
"Hey, Master Chen, you don't know something. Although our Li family is very strong and rich, we have offended many people over the years, and there are many powerful people. Moreover, my cousins died inexplicably in the capital last year. Who can guarantee the safety of my life? Of course, I just bought an insurance first. If one day our Li family really encounters a disaster, I hope Master Chen can help us."
Li Congcong looked at Chen Feng solemnly.
Li Congcong knew that Chen Feng was very strong. It was rare in his life to be able to split bullets with leaves. Such a powerful warrior could definitely help the Li family. He was looking for a protective shield for the Li family.
"Haha, okay, if one day comes, I will definitely help you. I won't get your villa in vain."
Chen Feng also smiled. After all, he was given a villa as a gift, so he had no reason to refuse.
